fusions.name: Rapid Knock
fusions.desc: A heavy peck that deals 15 damage, stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Levelling Beat
fusions.desc: Beats down on every enemy within 3 tiles for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Drumroll
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Steady Tapping
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 3 seconds.
